This checkpoint adds Yellow's Vermilion Gym teams: Lt. Surge uses level-28 Raichu with Thunderbolt, Mega Punch, Mega Kick and Growl. His three trainers use Yellow's species and levels. Winning awards the Thunder Badge and TM24 Thunderbolt. The native HeartGold switch puzzle and interior remain.

All prototype 0031 changes are included. Use Continue with a backed-up normal save.

Please test: the Gym's switches and trainers, Lt. Surge, the Thunder Badge and Thunderbolt reward, repeat dialogue, normal saving/reloading, and leaving the Gym. Report any problems reaching the Gym with your campaign save.

Verified: the native two-switch puzzle, Raichu battle, third badge, Thunderbolt receipt, normal save and pure-build Continue. Tests used an existing high-level copied party and a labeled initial-transport-only fixture before the Gym sequence; this is not a full campaign or balance test.

Unfinished: later Kanto progression, a fresh-save check of the exterior Cut dependency, junior trainer names/class artwork, and optional content/presentation. PC storage remains ten stacks; expansion is deferred. Existing completed features are preserved.
